item.title: Extract cmd-help to lazy-loaded module
item.intent: Extract all help functions (cmd_usage, cmd_help, _help_*) to .aishore/lib/cmd-help.sh — lazy-loaded on demand, ~270 lines removed from main script, dispatch updated, bash -n passes on both files.
steps: Identify all help functions in .aishore/aishore (cmd_usage, cmd_help, _help_compact, _help_run, _help_auto, _help_backlog, _help_groom, _help_review, _help_report, _help_metrics, _help_status, _help_update, _help_clean, _help_config, _help_init)
Create .aishore/lib/cmd-help.sh with all identified functions, following the same module header pattern as existing modules
Update dispatch table in main to call _load_module cmd-help before invoking cmd_help or cmd_usage
Run bash -n on both files to verify syntax
Run .aishore/aishore help and .aishore/aishore help run to verify output is unchanged
acceptanceCriteria: .aishore/aishore help produces identical output before and after
.aishore/aishore help run produces identical output before and after
wc -l .aishore/aishore shows at least 250 fewer lines than before this change
